title: FBS Actor Profile v1.0.0
description: Profile document for an actor exposed at /.well-known/fbs/webrecord endpoint. Declares actor identity, public key, capability set, and optional profile classification. Defined in RFC FBS0001 Section 4.1.3.

id.description: Actor Identifier (AID) of the form fbs://{node-host}/{actor-local-id}

profile.description: Human-readable profile name such as 'PublicUser', 'RetailOperator', 'Manufacturer', or custom profile name. Informational only; enforcement based on capabilities array.

displayName.description: Human-readable display name for this actor

node.description: HTTPS base URL of the node hosting this actor

outbox.description: HTTPS endpoint URL of the actor's outbox

publicKey.description: Actor's primary public key for signing records and federation messages

id.description: Unique identifier for this key, typically actor AID followed by #key-identifier

owner.description: Actor Identifier of the key owner

algorithm.description: Cryptographic algorithm. Currently only Ed25519 is supported.

publicKeyPem.description: The public key in PEM format

capabilities.description: Resolved capability set determining what operations this actor may perform. Normative source for access control decisions.

namespaceClaims.description: Array of HTTPS URLs pointing to active Namespace Claim objects for actors holding namespace:claim capability

verificationBadge.description: Optional Verification Badge for GS1-track Manufacturer actors. See RFC FBS0001 Section 4.5.3.

issued.description: UTC timestamp when badge was issued

issuedBy.description: Actor Identifier of the Trust Anchor or Verifier Quorum that issued this badge

encryptionKey.description: Optional X25519 public key for receiving encrypted metadata fields. See RFC FBS0001 Section 4.2.6.

id.description: Unique identifier for this encryption key

algorithm.description: Key agreement algorithm. MUST be X25519.

publicKeyPem.description: The X25519 public key in PEM format
